name: NovaPoshta API
description: Nova Poshta shipping integration for the Basket online store module.
project_description:
This module allows users to store the NovaPoshta cities/warehouses data in the database, using NovaPoshta API v2.0 .

 
In current module version we are support a next NovaPoshta methods:

 
 getCities 
 getWarehouses 
 
 Library for API: https://github.com/vladdancer/nova-poshta-guzzle 

 Requirements: 
 
 PHP 5.4+ 
 X Autoload 
 Composer Manager 
 
 Installation: 
 
 Install module. 
 Go to the admin page(admin/config/novaposhta)

 and set your API-key(you can get it from Nova Poshta user cabinet https://my.novaposhta.ua/settings/index#apikeys . Note: you should be registered to do so).
 
 Go to the "Synchronization page"(admin/config/novaposhta/sync) and push the button "Sync NP data". 
 Back to top
